name: org-opencypher-cypher
description: org-opencypher-cypher -- transitive npm dep of kotoba-lang/arrangement (via kotobase-query), needed to load arrangement.core under nbb (multiformats.core's @noble/hashes/sha2.js use). Mirrors kotobase-query's package.json exactly -- see that repo's comment for why io-multiformats' own vestigial "hashes" package.json entry is deliberately NOT mirrored here.
